headers.//: The free-scan page still carries an inline <script> and inline styles, so its policy has to permit them. The source lists are otherwise exact: every origin here is one the page actually loads from.

headers.value: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://www.gstatic.com https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://firestore.googleapis.com https://*.googleapis.com https://*.cloudfunctions.net https://*.run.app; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'

headers.//: The operator console keeps its script and styles in separate files and uses no inline handlers, so it gets the strict policy with no 'unsafe-inline' anywhere.

headers.value: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://*.run.app https://*.cloudfunctions.net; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'
